summary: First-iteration end-to-end smoke on Fuel Delivery MVP (React + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend public endpoints, RBAC, auto driver assignment, booking status transitions, driver release, and admin stats all verified via curl. Frontend flows verified with Playwright using session_token cookie: landing, customer dashboard (booking creation + live total), route protection, admin panel KPIs, driver creation. All critical paths working.
passed: Bearer token /api/auth/me returns admin/customer user objects correctly
Admin POST /api/drivers -> 200 with id and status='available'
Customer POST /api/bookings (petrol 25L) auto-assigns driver: status='assigned', driver_id/name populated, unit_price=106.5, total_price=2662.5
Delivered booking releases driver back to status='available'
GET /api/admin/stats returns correct revenue=2662.5, delivered=1, drivers_total/available
Landing / renders hero 'FUEL DELIVERED / ON THE SECOND', hero-google-signin-btn and nav-signin-btn visible
Customer cookie -> /dashboard renders booking-form; diesel + 40L updates total to ₹3,780.00 (94.5*40)
Admin cookie -> /admin loads admin-kpis; add-driver-btn creates driver 'Suresh' visible in table
notes: Non-blocking: 401 console errors observed on /auth/me before cookie is set / after cookie clear — expected behaviour. Test data (users, sessions, drivers, bookings) cleaned up post-run.
